_comment: Free Spin games lines-per-spin catalog. Used by src/fs-lines-resolver.js to compute value_per_spin = amount_per_line × lines_per_spin. Prefer inferring from game code prefix (vs<N> → N lines for Pragmatic Play). This file is the fallback override for non-PP2 providers or PP2 codes that don't follow the prefix pattern.
_convention_pp2: Pragmatic Play encodes lines in the code: vs20*=20 lines, vs25*=25 lines, vs40*=40 lines. The resolver handles this automatically — do not enumerate every vs20* game here.
_variable_lines: Megaways / 6x reels / cluster-pays games have no fixed line count. Mark them as null to force Sentinel INCONCLUSIVE (correct — cannot compare without runtime data).
_source: Populated 2026-07-02 during api-mapper-qp2 20x-overpayment recovery. Extend as new games appear.
